title_en: Axes of Agreement and Disagreement in the Mahdist Thesis
description_en: Axes of Agreement and Disagreement in the Mahdist Thesis, an episode of the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An episode examining the common ground and points of divergence concerning the Mahdist thesis.
